status: Frozen for Phase 2 by user approval; no models authorized
row_grain: One row per eligible observed user_id
timezone: UTC; SQL TIMESTAMP values are UTC without a stored timezone offset
eligibility: 37-day end <= coverage end and no declared whole-day logging gap intersects the history; eligibility is independent of purchase value
deduplication: Distinct on all nine original decoded CSV fields, before deterministic type parsing; raw unchanged
price_policy: Keep all activity; exclude negative/nonfinite prices from median-view-price; include zero; retain QA zero/negative counts; no imputation
session_policy: Distinct nonmissing session IDs per user within feature window
gap_policy: Keep feature_gap/outcome_gap as QA only; primary calendar avoids gap; broader assignment retained for later robustness
model_input_exclusions: user_id, target, timestamps, splits and every QA/gap column; model must use feature_columns allowlist only
assumptions: First observed is not necessarily new customer
No undetected logging loss outside identified gap
Event-time availability; no ingestion latency data
